pressReleaseTitle: Power Finance Corporation’s Acquisition of REC Limited to Stretch Former’s Balance Sheet
overview: On 6 December 2018, the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs gave in-principle approval for the strategic sale of the government of India’s (GoI) 52.63% stake in the total paid-up equity capital of REC Limited (‘IND AAA’/Stable) to Power Finance Corporation (PFC; Fitch Ratings Ltd: Issuer Default Rating: ‘BBB-’/Stable). REC is likely to continue to be a separate entity.
